# Camena

Camena adapts the Obsidian interface to a chosen accent color so that every interface element and defined-hue color responds consistently. The result is an accent-driven palette applied uniformly across panes, panels and syntax highlighting.

![Camena screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/splendidissimemendax/Camena/HEAD/Thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Camena"
    author: "splendidissimemendax"
    repo:   "splendidissimemendax/Camena"
    slug:   "camena"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/camena"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/splendidissimemendax/Camena"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/splendidissimemendax/Camena/HEAD/Thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Adapt Obsidian’s interface to a chosen accent color, making every UI element and defined-hue color respond consistently. Create a cohesive, accent-driven palette across panes, panels, and syntax highlighting for a uniform visual experience."
}
```
